input.instruction: In /testbed (Biome repo), find the noUnusedVariables rule (crates/biome_js_analyze/src/lint/correctness/no_unused_variables.rs) and how it handles Astro/HTML-ish files (grep for 'astro' / is_astro / EmbeddingKind in that file and in semantic model / services). Report relevant code snippets with line numbers, especially anything that skips or special-cases Astro frontmatter, and how text in template `{text}` expressions is used (is the frontmatter's semantic model aware of references in the template body?). Also check git log -3 for hints.

content.content: {"summary":"noUnusedVariables does not skip Astro frontmatter. It has one Astro special case, which ignores a top-level `Props` type or interface. The frontmatter's semantic model does not see the template. Template `{expr}` text is parsed as separate embedded snippets, and the rule checks it by name through an `EmbeddedService` (a database lookup keyed by file path). I did not trace the code in biome_workspace_db that fills that lookup.","findings":["no_unused_variables.rs:18 imports JsEmbeddingKind. The doc comment at lines 111-120 says an Astro top-level interface or type alias named `Props` is always ignored.","no_unused_variables.rs:375-379: the rule gets `EmbeddedService` and `file_source = ctx.source_type::<JsFileSource>()`.","no_unused_variables.rs:412-428: `is_defined_in_embedded_binding` is true when the current file is not an embedded source and `embedded.contains_binding(name)` is true. It also requires the declaration to be an import specifier (default, namespace, named or shorthand) or a JsVariableDeclarator. If true, the binding is not reported.","no_unused_variables.rs:429-433: `is_used_as_reference = embedded.is_used(name)`, plus `is_svelte_store_used` for Svelte only. Underscore-prefixed names, `is_defined_in_embedded_binding` and `is_used_as_reference` all return None early (line 435).","no_unused_variables.rs:437-448: the Astro special case. If the name is `Props`, the embedding kind is `JsEmbeddingKind::Astro`, and the binding is a TsIdentifierBinding in a TsInterfaceDeclaration or TsTypeAliasDeclaration directly under a JsModuleItemList, the rule returns None.","no_unused_variables.rs:450-461: `is_unused(model, binding)` is the normal semantic-model check. Svelte `$bindable` props are exempted there. There is no Astro-specific branch.","services/embedded.rs:25-60: `EmbeddedService` wraps `Rc<dyn LanguageDb>` and a path. It exposes contains_binding, contains_binding_text, is_used_as_value, is_used_as_type, is_used and is_svelte_store_used. All of them query biome_workspace_db::embedded::{bindings,references}.","biome_service/src/embed/html.rs:322-332: `resolve_text_expression_language` treats `{text}` expressions in Astro files as `GuestLanguage::Tsx`, and as `JsModule` in other HTML-like files.","Conclusion: the frontmatter's own semantic model is not aware of template references. Awareness comes only from the by-name `embedded.is_used(...)` lookup. Because it matches by name, shadowing is not considered.","git log -3 shows only e60574cc 'baseline' and dec3c22d 'refactor(md/parse): fold code content lines...'. Neither gives a hint about Astro."],"confidence":0.8}

{"summary":"In the Astro branch of parse_embedded_nodes.rs, `{text}` on a tag is parsed as HtmlAttributeSingleTextExpression but is never matched, so it is never embedded. Nothing was run or edited.","findings":["Parser: crates/biome_html_parser/src/syntax/mod.rs:~940 (parse_single_text_expression) completes HTML_ATTRIBUTE_SINGLE_TEXT_EXPRESSION when the context is InsideTag/InsideTagAstro/InsideTagSvelte. Otherwise it completes HTML_SINGLE_TEXT_EXPRESSION. I did not trace the Astro attribute caller, so the node kind for `<MyComponent {text} />` is inferred from this and not confirmed. Astro spread `{...x}` becomes HTML_SPREAD_ATTRIBUTE (astro.rs:~72).","Astro embeds in crates/biome_service/src/file_handlers/html/parse_embedded_nodes.rs, HtmlVariant::Astro branch (~lines 90-135): AstroEmbeddedContent (frontmatter), HtmlSingleTextExpression (children text only), HtmlElement (script/style), AnyAstroDirective initializer, HtmlAttribute initializer (`id={expr}`), and HtmlSpreadAttribute. HtmlAttributeSingleTextExpression is missing.","The Svelte branch (~lines 340-355) already handles it: HtmlAttributeSingleTextExpression whose parent is not HtmlAttributeInitializerClause. The parent check avoids double-embedding `id={expr}`, which the HtmlAttribute initializer branch already covers.","embed/html.rs needs no change. resolve_text_expression_language returns Tsx for Astro, and the TextExpression detector matches any TextExpression candidate.","Fix: add this block in the Astro loop after the HtmlSingleTextExpression block: `if let Some(attr) = HtmlAttributeSingleTextExpression::cast_ref(&element) && !attr.syntax().parent().is_some_and(|p| HtmlAttributeInitializerClause::can_cast(p.kind())) && let Ok(expression) = attr.expression() && let Some(candidate) = build_text_expression_candidate(&expression) { ctx.parse_and_push(&candidate, &doc_file_source, None, &mut nodes); }`. The imports already exist at lines 13-14.","Existing tests in crates/biome_js_analyze/tests/specs/correctness/noUnusedVariables: valid-astro-attribute-expressions.astro (only `id={x}` forms, no shorthand), valid-astro-directive-expressions.astro, valid-astro-embedded-bindings.astro, valid_issue_9589.astro. Also noUnusedImports/valid-astro-template-usage.astro. None covers `<MyComponent {text} />`.","Suggested new test: noUnusedVariables/valid-astro-shorthand-attribute.astro with the issue input, no diagnostics expected. Also add a snapshot."],"confidence":0.8}

content.content: {"summary":"`HtmlSingleTextExpression` appears 5 times in parse_embedded_nodes.rs: the import, three `cast_ref` uses, and one doc comment. I printed 15 lines of context around each match. I didn't paste the context here.","findings":["parse_embedded_nodes.rs:14: imported in the `use biome_html_syntax::{...}` list.","parse_embedded_nodes.rs:65: `HtmlSingleTextExpression::cast_ref(&element)` in the Standard variant, under the `HtmlTextExpressions::Single` arm. It builds a text-expression candidate and calls `ctx.parse_and_push`.","parse_embedded_nodes.rs:96: `cast_ref` in the Astro variant loop. It builds a candidate and calls `ctx.parse_and_push`.","parse_embedded_nodes.rs:265: `cast_ref` in the Svelte variant loop. It pushes the node onto `snippet_expressions` for later processing, and `HtmlElement` nodes are collected in the same pass.","parse_embedded_nodes.rs:711: doc comment on `build_text_expression_candidate` (defined at line 713). It names `HtmlSingleTextExpression` as one of the outer wrappers the caller extracts the inner `HtmlTextExpression` from."],"confidence":0.97}
